title: Want to love this but…
body:
I use this app a lot obviously. But there’s a few hiccups:

1. The responses for handwritten notes are VERY laggy. I’m using the pencil pro on an M4 iPad Pro with iOS 18 and thought that after the update it would be better but alas. The issue persisted even with wifi off (I thought it’s a sync issue). Before any rebuttals are submitted, I usually only have 2 to 3 apps opened - not on multitask.

2. Handwritten notes again, iOS 18 promised a cleanup of handwriting, but in addition to a slow and jittery AI recognition that most times, completely ignore this feature, when it does recognise the handwriting, it distorts the horizontal layout and instead, making it crooked. How I know? I use a ruled layout and instead of cleaning out my handwriting, it transforms my notes to a diagonal writing. 

Please brush this up ASAP, especially since the pencil pro writing feature is the main reason I bought this iPad instead of a Samsung tablet.
